self.onmessage=async function(event){const {id,data,settings}=event.data;try{if(event.data.exportType){const {mesh,type,title}=event.data.exportType;const blob=type==='stl'?new Blob([RS.stl(mesh)],{type:'model/stl'}):RS.model3mf(mesh,title);self.postMessage({id,blob});return;}RS.meshProgress=progress=>self.postMessage({id,progress});let result;if(event.data.surveyURL){const {buildSurface}=await import(new URL('surface-build.mjs',event.data.surveyURL).href);result=await buildSurface(RS,data,settings);}else result=RS.buildMesh(data,settings);const transfer=[result.vertices.buffer,result.indices.buffer,result.classes.buffer];if(result.indices.length>24000){const p=result.preview=RS.previewSurface(result);transfer.push(p.vertices.buffer,p.indices.buffer,p.classes.buffer);}self.postMessage({id,result},transfer);}catch(e){self.postMessage({id,error:e.message,code:e.code||'GEOMETRY_ERROR',stack:e.stack||'',diagnostics:e.diagnostics||null});}finally{delete RS.meshProgress;}};
